exclusions.reason: Static image and SVG assets (photos, icons, decorative blobs) are referenced by HTML/CSS but own no rendered UI logic and are not valid point-and-edit source anchors.
Figma Make tooling configuration files are not UI source anchors.
Claude Code harness configuration and permission files are not rendered UI source and must never be selected as a point-and-edit anchor.
Git internals are not source files of any kind.
Markdown files are design and domain documentation; they contain no rendered UI source.
Foundation documentation files describe system design decisions and contain no rendered UI source.
Domain documentation files describe product intent and contain no rendered UI source.

generated.explanation: Repository is a fully self-contained vanilla HTML/CSS/JS prototype with no framework, build system, or node_modules; all rendered UI is enumerable across exactly 10 files (8 HTML screens, main.css, main.js), making the complete source anchor set deterministic with very high confidence.
